rules.rule_text:
title: Sysmon Driver Altitude Change
id: 4916a35e-bfc4-47d0-8e25-a003d7067061
status: test
description: 'Detects changes in Sysmon driver altitude value.

  If the Sysmon driver is configured to load at an altitude of another registered
  service, it will fail to load at boot.

  '
references:
- https://posts.specterops.io/shhmon-silencing-sysmon-via-driver-unload-682b5be57650
- https://youtu.be/zSihR3lTf7g
- https://github.com/trustedsec/SysmonCommunityGuide/blob/557dbd51b98952bc26f698620e48dfc7833b5cf0/chapters/the-sysmon-driver.md
- https://medium.com/@matterpreter/shhmon-silencing-sysmon-via-driver-unload-682b5be57650
author: B.Talebi
date: 2022-07-28
modified: 2026-11-16
tags:
- attack.defense-impairment
- attack.t1685
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains: \Services\
    TargetObject|endswith: \Instances\Sysmon Instance\Altitude
  filter_main_default_altitude:
    Details: 385201
  condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate driver altitude change to hide sysmon
level: high
